citing_sentence: Loss-of-function variants in PIEZO2 impair proprioception in affected individuals.

cited_claimed.title: Piezo2 is the principal mechanotransduction channel for proprioception

cited_abstract: We show that Piezo2 is the principal mechanotransduction channel for proprioception in mice.

cited_sections.label: results
cited_sections.title: Piezo2 in proprioceptors
cited_sections.text: Conditional deletion of Piezo2 in sensory neurons abolished rapidly adapting mechanically activated currents in proprioceptors. Animals showed severely uncoordinated body movements and abnormal limb positions.

cited_sections.label: methods
cited_sections.title: Mouse lines
cited_sections.text: Piezo2 conditional knockout mice were generated by crossing Piezo2 floxed animals with a sensory-neuron-specific Cre driver.
